title: Bounded n-part composition with cap honesty (cortex 0.4.0): MAX_COMPOSITION 2 -> 4, cap-dropped parts named truthfully, aggregate solver-budget refusal, learning reorders before the cap

roles.founder_intent_steward: The Competency Compiler target recruits 'the smallest competent mechanism or composition'; review row B47 names 'recombination beyond two parts' as the known not-yet, and rows A36/A52/B27/B31/B36 all carry the composition clause as unfinished. The founder correction of 2026-10-03 (INTENT-0036) makes this slice mandatory-now: it is independently buildable (no verdict, outcomes, model, attach, or spend), and N1's local gate does not block it. The meniscus translation controls the bound: the composition cap is a hard resource/coupling frontier, so the cap stays — what changes is that parts it drops are named honestly, because a receipt that reports a required, eligible part as 'not required by this payload' is a false statement about the problem, and proximity to a truthfulness boundary is not a performance objective.
roles.systems_architect: One-file change inside the existing coordinator (cortex/routing.py): selection becomes eligible-parts -> memory reorder -> cap at MAX_COMPOSITION=4; cap-dropped parts are computed set-theoretically (eligible minus selected) and rendered in alternatives as 'required by this payload and eligible; dropped by the composition bound (MAX_COMPOSITION=4, cortex-route-policy/0.4.0)'; the receipt's route object gains max_parts and cap_dropped (schema allows additional properties; the boolean composition field is unchanged). Aggregate solver demand is planned as the count of solver-calling organs selected and refused before spending when it exceeds max_solver_calls. No new organ, registry, authority path, or learning system; version coupling follows the established pattern: contracts 0.4.0, policy 0.4.0, catalog 0.4.0, traceability 0.4.0, examples regenerated at the fixed clock, and a NEW freeze-v0.4.0.json (v0.3.0 and both crossgeo freezes hash-pinned in tests).
roles.adversarial_reviewer: Strongest attacks, each with a control: (1) The cap raise could silently multiply spend — control: aggregate pre-spend refusal now counts solver-calling parts (3 solver callers with budget 2 is BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with zero organs run; tested). (2) Cap honesty could mislabel — control: the cap-dropped set is computed as (eligible parts) minus (selected), so a part cannot be labeled cap-dropped unless it was required and eligible; ineligible parts keep their real reasons (tested via founder-detach projection: 'withheld by host registry'); unrequired parts keep 'not required by this payload'. (3) Memory could widen the cap by reordering — control: reorder permutes eligible parts only, the cap slices after reordering, and the ledger's never-widen-eligibility invariant is untouched (existing memory tests hold). (4) Freeze contamination — control: a new manifest file per version; the prior three freezes are sha256-pinned in the test file. (5) The EXTRACT->FORMAL chain could exceed the cap — it is one logical part (extraction compiles INTO the formal slot); the receipt lists every executed key, so the chain is visible, never hidden.
roles.operator_maintainer: Operational surface: behavior changes only for payloads with three or more eligible parts (previously cap-dropped parts now run, up to 4) and for solver-budget accounting (now aggregate). Both are disclosed in the receipt. Default budgets (0.05 USD, 64 solver calls) admit the new worst case; CPU bounds per organ are unchanged. Rollback: close the draft PR unmerged, revert the merge commit, or pin cortex-route-policy/0.3.0 behavior by reverting the single routing.py hunk — no state, no migration, no external effect exists to roll back. The slice runs behind the same entry; nothing is enabled that was disabled.
roles.evidence_welfare_guardian: No external effects, participants, or data subjects; all tests are deterministic fixtures with stubbed formed organs (no network, no engine trust). Evidence tiers: unit_test and deterministic_fixture only — no outcome or benchmark claim is made or implied; B55's promotion rule (a combination must beat every constituent alone) stays gated at N3 and this slice claims no gain. Negative evidence preserved: the two worktree suite failures (frozen ancestry locks reacting to off-branch objects present in this long-lived worktree) are recorded as environment artifacts, demonstrated pre-slice at d31848a; the canonical green comes from the fresh-clone replication. Nothing was deleted.

alternatives.name: Raise the bound to 4 with cap honesty, aggregate solver-budget refusal, and reorder-before-cap inside the existing coordinator
alternatives.benefits: Serves six register rows with the smallest sufficient intervention; fixes the truthfulness defect; spend stays hard-bounded; learning (when outcomes exist) decides which parts survive the cap; freeze discipline becomes test-pinned
alternatives.liabilities: Richer payloads can now spend up to 4 organ calls inside budget; the alternatives list grows a third honesty category to maintain
alternatives.rollback: Close the draft PR unmerged; revert the merge commit; no state or external effect exists
alternatives.kill_criteria: If any cap-dropped part is ever reported as 'not required by this payload', or any organ runs after an aggregate budget refusal, kill and re-issue

alternatives.name: Keep MAX_COMPOSITION=2 and the current alternatives text
alternatives.benefits: Zero new code; zero new spend surface
alternatives.liabilities: B47's named not-yet stays open against an explicit founder correction ordering independently buildable work to continue; the receipt keeps stating a falsehood (required, eligible parts reported as 'not required by this payload') on every 3+-part payload

alternatives.name: Unbounded composition: select every eligible part and rely on budget refusal alone
alternatives.benefits: No cap-honesty category needed; maximal recombination
alternatives.liabilities: Removes the hard coupling frontier the meniscus translation requires; a 7-part payload would always plan 7 organs, pushing refusal into the budget path on every rich question and coupling the receipt to worst-case planner behavior; the bound is what keeps composition auditable

alternatives.name: This slice is itself the reversible experiment: the change is additive inside one function, observable in every receipt (max_parts, cap_dropped), and reversible by reverting one hunk with no state to migrate
alternatives.benefits: Tests n-part composition and cap honesty in review with zero irreversibility; every served receipt discloses the bound and any drop
alternatives.evidence: sandbox_execution: verifier v4 V3-V5 exercise 3-part composition, 5-part cap honesty, and aggregate refusal end to end
alternatives.rollback: Revert the routing.py hunk; receipts from 0.4.0 remain valid historical records
alternatives.kill_criteria: If composition ever hides an executed part from the receipt, kill and re-issue

passes.summary: Intended outcome independent of mechanism: a problem carrying several structured parts is attacked by all of the parts that are competent for it, up to a hard bound; the bound's victims are named truthfully; aggregate resource demand is refused before spending; learning (when real outcomes exist) orders eligible parts before the bound bites. Reversal condition: if the cap raise let spend or coupling grow unboundedly, the slice reverses into a liability; the controls are the aggregate pre-spend refusal and the unchanged per-organ budgets.

disadvantages.text: More parts per payload means more spend per question
disadvantages.handling: resolved by design: planned cost, model calls, and now solver calls are all summed over the selection and refused before spending; the defaults admit the 4-part worst case; tested (V5)

disadvantages.text: Cap honesty could itself lie (mislabel a part)
disadvantages.handling: resolved by construction: cap_dropped = eligible minus selected; the phrase attaches only to that set; ineligible parts keep registry reasons (V4 plus the founder-detach test)

disadvantages.text: Memory reorder could be read as learning widening the composition
disadvantages.handling: bounded: reorder permutes eligible parts only, before the cap; it cannot add a part or raise the bound; the ledger's never-widen invariant is untouched

disadvantages.text: The EXTRACT->FORMAL chain can extend the receipt's selected list beyond 4
disadvantages.handling: accepted with disclosure: the chain is one logical part (extraction compiles into the formal slot); every executed key appears in the receipt

disadvantages.text: Version bump could contaminate the frozen evaluation
disadvantages.handling: resolved by discipline made executable: new freeze-v0.4.0.json file; the three prior freezes are sha256-pinned in tests (V6)

passes.summary: Re-attacked as deployed. Bureaucracy: one routing hunk, one test file, one verifier version, one partition artifact, one draft PR — no new ceremony. Centralization: composition centralizes recruitment in the one coordinator, not authority; no new authority is created (authority_created false on every receipt). Fragility: the change is set arithmetic on an existing list; the frozen-spec and freeze-pin tests fail loudly on drift. Gaming: a part cannot game selection — eligibility is hard-gated per part geometry, and the cap phrase is computable only by being eligible and unselected. Dependence on one model: every claim cites an executable test or verifier check runnable by any contributor.

passes.residual_risk: Composition is parallel part execution with typed proofs, not yet cross-part inference (deterrence does not yet consume the causal part's estimate); that deeper composition is the metaconsensus/VOI queue. The receipt discloses the parts and their proofs; it does not claim their combination beats any constituent — that claim stays N3-gated.

dissent.strongest_objection: Raising the cap before N1 has a verdict lets the cortex do more while its comparative advantage is unproven — capability breadth ahead of evidence. The partition answers this: the slice is an engineering dependency of the full-Mind directive, not an evaluation dependency of N1; it manufactures no promotion evidence, spends nothing unauthorized, and contaminates no freeze. But the ordering concern is real: if GAIN_ABSENT ever returns, this composition work survives only as infrastructure, not as validated advantage.
dissent.resolution_threshold: If the N1 verdict is GAIN_ABSENT, the composition machinery is re-reviewed as infrastructure-only: it may remain for gates/verifier value, but no capability-breadth claim may be made from it.
dissent.review_trigger: the N1 verdict, or any receipt whose composition claim exceeds what its per-part proofs establish
